mapper.select: select shijuanmingcheng, sum(case when kaoshichengji <= 60 then 1 else 0 end) as 不及格, sum(case when kaoshichengji >= 61 and kaoshichengji <= 79 then 1 else 0 end) as 及格, sum(case when kaoshichengji >= 81 and kaoshichengji <= 90 then 1 else 0 end) as 良好, sum(case when kaoshichengji >= 91 and kaoshichengji <= 100 then 1 else 0 end) as 优秀 from chengjixinxi 1=1 ${ew.sqlSegment} group by shijuanmingcheng
